design.purpose: A compact open planter for herbs or flowers on a patio, giving about 18 cm of soil depth above the base.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for measuring.
Mark the base at 40 cm.
Cut the 40 cm base from the board.
Place the second board flat for measuring.
Mark 40 cm, 40 cm, 16 cm and 16 cm sections.
Cut front, back and both end pieces.
Sand cut edges smooth on all five parts.
Place the base flat, top face up.
Drill three drainage holes through the base.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between the sides.
Fit the right end between the sides.
Screw the front side to the left end.
Screw the front side to the right end.
Screw the back side to the left end.
Screw the back side to the right end.
Screw the base up into the front side.
Screw the base up into the back side.
Screw the base up into the left end.
Screw the base up into the right end.
